name: medris
description: Levromart marketplace: the web app (medris-frontend, deployed on Vercel with the original api/*.js functions) and the new Express + TypeScript backend (medris-backend, not deployed yet).

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w medris-backend & npm run dev -w medris-frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w medris-backend && node scripts/check-deploy-env.mjs && npm run build -w medris-frontend
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
